gloss: to bill; to charge; to demand

definitions.gloss: to bill; to charge; to invoice
definitions.explanation: To formally request payment for goods or services provided.

definitions.gloss: to demand; to claim; to request formally
definitions.explanation: To make a formal demand or claim, often in a legal or official context.

examples.japanese: {修理代|しゅうりだい}を{請求|せいきゅう}された。
examples.english: I was charged for the repair costs.

examples.japanese: クレジットカードに{高額|こうがく}な{料金|りょうきん}が{請求|せいきゅう}されていた。
examples.english: A large charge had been billed to my credit card.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}に{交通費|こうつうひ}を{請求|せいきゅう}するのを{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to claim your transportation expenses from the company.

examples.japanese: {損害賠償|そんがいばいしょう}を{請求|せいきゅう}する。
{弁護士|べんごし}を{通|とお}して{慰謝料|いしゃりょう}を{請求|せいきゅう}した。
examples.english: I demanded consolation money through a lawyer.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}は{裁判所|さいばんしょ}に{権利|けんり}の{回復|かいふく}を{請求|せいきゅう}した。
examples.english: The victim demanded restoration of rights from the court.

notes:
Covers both billing/invoicing (sense 1) and formal demands/claims (sense 2). The noun form {請求|せいきゅう} is very common in business and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: invoice; bill
- {請求額|せいきゅうがく}: billed amount
- {請求先|せいきゅうさき}: billing address; party to be billed
- {損害賠償請求|そんがいばいしょうせいきゅう}: claim for damages
- {不当請求|ふとうせいきゅう}: unjust billing; fraudulent charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {要求|ようきゅう}する: to demand — broader, used for any demand including informal ones
- {催促|さいそく}する: to urge payment — focuses on reminding someone to pay or act
- {徴収|ちょうしゅう}する: to collect (taxes, fees) — used by authorities collecting payments
